NATURAL AND MAN-MADE THINGS
There are two types of things:
Natural Things Man-made Things
Things that are given to us by nature are called natural things.
For example: birds, trees, fruits, flowers, etc.
Things that are made by man are called man-made things.
For example: chair, book, table, cycle, etc.
WHAT IS A MACHINE?
A machine is a man-made thing. It makes our work easier. It also helps us do our work quickly and saves our time. Let us have a look at some machines.
Some machines work on electricity.
Some machines run on fuel.
Some machines run on human power.
Some machines run on batteries or cells.
COMPUTER– A SMART MACHINE
A computer is a smart machine.
It runs on electricity.
Here are some key features of a computer:
It never gets tired.
A computer works very fast.
It can store and remember a lot of information.
It can do many things.
It never gets bored doing the same work again and again.
It never makes mistakes if programmed correctly.
It makes our work easy.
Charles Babbage is known as the father of the computer.

KEYBOARD
As we use a pencil or a pen to write in our notebook, we need a keyboard to type anything on a computer. Writing on a computer is called typing.
The buttons on a keyboard are called keys. You can type on a computer with the help of these keys.
A keyboard has different types of keys. They are:
Alphabet keys Number or Numeric keys Special keys
ALPHABET KEYS
The keys that display letters from A to Z are called alphabet keys. These keys are used to type letters, words and sentences. There are 26 alphabet keys on a keyboard.
The alphabet keys are not in alphabetical order. They are present in QWERTY format.

NUMBER OR NUMERIC KEYS The keys on which you see numbers from 0 to 9 are called number keys. These keys are used for typing numbers. You find these keys at two places on a keyboard. So, there are 20 number keys (10 on the top row and 10 on the numeric keypad).
SPECIAL KEYS There are some special keys on a keyboard. These keys are used for specific tasks such as moving to the next line on a page, etc.
Some of the special keys are as follows:
Enter key Spacebar key Caps Lock key
Delete key Backspace key
Enter key: Enter key: The Enter key is used to move to the next line. Most keyboards have two Enter keys.
Spacebar key: Spacebar key: The Spacebar key is used to add blank space between letters, words or numbers. It is the longest key on a keyboard.
Caps Lock key: Caps Lock key: The Caps Lock key is used to
type letters in capital form.
Delete key: Delete key: The Delete key erases the letters or numbers after the cursor.
Backspace key: Backspace key: The Backspace key is used to
erase the letters typed before the cursor.

COMPUTER MOUSE
A mouse is an important part of a computer. It looks like a real mouse. It is small in size. It has two or three buttons. It is connected to the CPU with a long wire that looks like a tail.
In the middle, it has a small wheel known as
the scroll button.
It has a glowing light under it.
We can select and open things on the monitor
by pressing the buttons of a computer mouse.
We can draw pictures and play games using
it.
Nowadays computer mouses are wireless too.
Mouse Pad Mouse Pad
A mouse is usually placed on a soft, flat surface called a mouse pad. A mouse pad helps the mouse work smoothly and properly.
Mouse Pointer Mouse Pointer
The small arrow on the screen is called the mouse pointer. It is used to point on something on the monitor. When we move the mouse, the arrow moves on the screen.
Mouse Clicking Mouse Clicking
Pressing a button on the mouse is called clicking.
Single-click: Single-click: When we click the left mouse button once, this is called a single-click or a left-click.
Double-click: Double-click: When we click the left mouse button twice quickly, it is called a double-click.
Right-click: Right-click: When we click the right mouse button once, it is called a right-click.
Drag and Drop: Drag and Drop: Moving a mouse while holding down the left button is called dragging.
Releasing the mouse button after dragging is called a drop.

A computer is a machine. So, we should handle it with care. Let us learn the correct steps to turn it on and turn off.
HOW TO START A COMPUTER?
To start a computer, follow these steps:
Step 1: Step 1: Turn on the main power supply button.
Step 2: Step 2: Turn on the UPS button.
Step 3: Step 3: Turn on the power supply button of the
CPU cabinet.
Step 4: Step 4: Turn on the monitor power button and
wait for some time.
After a short time, the screen will appear on monitor.
Starting and Shutting
Down a Computer
Chapter Chapter
Desktop Icons
Start Button Taskbar Notification Area
Windows 10 is the most popular operating system that makes the computer work.
The first screen that appears on starting a computer is known as the desktop.
The desktop holds many small pictures, known as icons.
The taskbar is a thin bar located at the bottom of the desktop.
It contains a start button in the leftmost corner of the taskbar. When you click on this button, a list of options or programs appears. This list is known as the Start Menu.
The sequence of actions done by a computer when it is switched on is called startup startup. This is also known as Booting Booting.
Fact to act to Know now
HOW TO SHUT DOWN A COMPUTER?
When we finish a task using the computer, we should shut it down properly to save our work and electricity. The action of closing all the activities and turning the computer off is called Shut Down.
To shut down a computer, follow these steps:
Step 1: Step 1: Click on the start button.
Step 2: Step 2: Click on the power
options button
in the lower-right corner of the start menu.
Step 3: Step 3: Select the shut
down option from the list appeared.
Now, wait for some time till the computer shuts down automatically.
The light on the CPU is off now.
Step 4: Step 4: Now, turn off the monitor too.
Step 5: Step 5: Then, turn off the UPS too.
Step 6: Step 6: And finally, switch off the power supply button.

What is a Sequence?
Today, computers are everywhere. Computers are in phones, watches, and even cars. Every computer works by following instructions.
Have you ever thought about creating your own computer instructions? You could make a computer do whatever you want. It is only possible by coding.
WHAT IS CODING?

Coding is the process of giving instructions to a computer to perform a specific task. Unlike humans, computers are not naturally smart. They need very specific instructions written in a language they can understand.
BENEFITS OF CODING
The benefits of coding include:
It enhances creativity.
It builds logical thinking.
Coding
Chapter Chapter
It improves problem solving skills.
It teaches maths skills.
It improves communication skills.

We use computers to solve problems, play games, etc. They help us to work more effectively, perform repetitive tasks, store and recall information, create new things, and connect with friends and the world.
Everyone can learn to code; it’s just like solving a puzzle or riddle. You apply logic, test your solution, try again, and solve the problem. Now it’s your turn to start coding.
WHAT IS A SEQUENCE?
A sequence is a set of instructions to complete a task given to a computer. Let’s learn a few coding commands:
Move one square forward
Move one square backward
Move one square down
Move one square up
Change to next colour
Fill in square with colour
For example:
Step 1. Step 1. Move one square forward.
Step 2. Step 2. Move one square forward.
Step 3. Step 3. Fill in square with colour.

WHAT IS ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI)?

Artificial Intelligence means making computers and machines smart so that they can learn from information and do tasks like humans. AI learns from the information given to it. AI cannot feel emotions like people but it can think in a smart, programmed way and perform tasks very quickly and accurately without getting tired. AI helps humans work faster and smarter.
Simple Examples of AI Simple Examples of AI
You see AI around you every day.
Your mobile phone unlocks by looking at your face (Face ID).
Chapter Chapter

like.
Google Maps tells the fastest way to
reach a place.

closures and accidents.
Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa (Voice
assistant) answers your
questions.
Video games become
smarter the more you play.
AI is like a smart helper — not a human.
AI AND NATURE
AI also learns from nature.
Scientists observe how animals, birds, and plants work — and then
create smart machines using those ideas.
Examples from Nature Examples from Nature
Birds flying together helped people design flying drones.
Ants finding food fast helped
computers learn how to find the shortest
path.
Our brain’s working helped scientists
make robots and computers.
Nature shows us how to move, learn, and solve problems. AI copies
these ideas to work in a smarter way!
